## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling confirm mixed risk signals alongside neutral credit (HYG (1W: -0.47% | 1M: -0.31%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -0.72% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION).  

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear rising via VXX (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; credit tone neutral as HYG/LQD shows no clear lift (HYG BELOW TREND / LQD CORRECTION). Energy/commodity repricing (BNO (1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; USO (1W: +20.73% | 1M: +24.32%) ABOVE TREND) is a separate inflation/real-economy driver.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Mixed/neutral: SPY/TLT signal flat overall with SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -1.31% | 1M: +2.68%) → duration bid on the month but recent pullback. Dollar and yield proxies neutral per the barometer.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; Communication showing strength: (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND. Technology mixed: XLK (1W: -0.59% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; Style: growth/tech not confirming leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US weak-to-neutral: SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND; EM/China under pressure with EEM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -3.31%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -4.84% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Select international pockets still offer divergence but overall global equities lag US.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Crypto recovery signs: IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; small caps weak: IWM (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.29%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, indicating risk appetite is selective and narrow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Broad commodity strength led by oil and related ETFs: BNO (1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +20.73% | 1M: +24.32%) ABOVE TREND; metals mixed with GLD (1W: -2.38% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy cycle robust: XLE (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; natural gas showing a short-term bounce UNG (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -7.16%) RECOVERY but remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE 1W and 1M positive) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals (TLT, GLD, XLU, XLRE) and narrow sector breadth (3/11) = MINOR-to-MAJOR mixed signals; treat broad regime as NEUTRAL not Risk-On/Off.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to energy/commodity ETFs showing strength (XLE, BNO, USO) and monitor IBIT for speculative re-entry signals; reduce exposure to China/EM ETFs (FXI, EEM) and monitor tech (XLK) which is BELOW TREND and not confirming leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND if oil momentum holds.  
BEARISH: Financials/Industrials if sector breadth fails to recover — watch Financials breadth (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -5.07%) and XME (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Oil — BNO (1W: +19.02% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +20.73% | 1M: +24.32%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Precious metals if GLD (1W: -2.38% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND continue to weaken.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20–25 (elevated readings signal sustained fear), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio ~1.0 (style pivot), BNO/USO momentum above recent 1M gains (>+20%) to confirm commodity leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: +13.17% | 1M: +15.03%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.19%) BELOW TREND show mixed signals. Energy/commodities (XLE, BNO, USO) showing strength while tech (XLK) and EM (EEM, FXI) show weakness; monitor TLT/GLD CORRECTION divergences.
